name: AR_CC_ERROR_MAPPINGS
description: The AR_CC_ERROR_MAPPINGS table contains the mapping between credit card errors and their corresponding corrective actions. Based on these corrective mappings, Receivables will automatically correct any credit card error that occurs during automatic receipt or remittance batch processing.

columns.name: CC_ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code from credit card payment processor

columns.name: CC_ERROR_MAP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of credit card error mappings

columns.name: CC_ERROR_TEXT
columns.description: User-enterable description for credit card error code

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of receipt method.Foreign key to AR_RECEIPT_METHODS_ALL.RECEIPT_METHOD_ID.

columns.name: CC_TRX_CATEGORY
columns.description: Transaction category for credit card errors. Based on lookup CC_TRX_CATEGORY.

columns.name: CC_ACTION_CODE
columns.description:
Corrective action to be performed on transactions with errors. Based on lookup
AR_CC_ACTION_CODES.

columns.name: NO_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days after which a subsequent corrective action can be performed. If no subsequent action exists, transaction will appear for manual correction after specified number of days.

columns.name: SUBSEQUENT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Subsequent action that will be performed after first action is performed.

columns.name: ERROR_NOTES
columns.description: User-enterable notes, attached to corrected transaction

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RULE_PRIORITY
columns.description: Number that identifies the rule priority, with the lowest number equal to the highest priority. If a transaction falls under more than one rule, select the rule with the highest priority.

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: Maximum number of retries for a rule with the Retry action.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the rule is enabled.

columns.name: FINAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Lookup codes under the AR_CC_ACTION_CODES lookup type that determine the final corrective action to take on the transaction if the maximum number of retires fails. Valid values are CLR PAY INFO and REV REC.

columns.name: RETRY_UOM_CODE
columns.description: Lookup codes under the ORA_AR_RCPT_RETRY_UOM lookup type that determine the chronological unit of measure to use to define the interval between retries. Valid values are Minutes, Hours, and Days.

columns.name: RETRY_INTERVAL
columns.description: Number that identifies the length of the interval between retries according to the chronological unit of measure.

columns.name: RETRY_SCHEDULE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code under the ORA_AR_RETRY_SCHEDULE lookup type that determines the name that identifies the retry schedule containing the Retry action definitions. Valid value is Incremental.
